description: Make a short product video from the photo and name on a public product page. If the page can't be read, upload a product photo and describe the scene.
h1: URL to Video: Turn a Product Link into a Video Ad
lead: Paste your product page link and get a short product video made from the photo and name on that page.
secondary_keywords: turn a link into a video

steps.d: A public product page for an item you sell.

steps.t: Check the product and name it found
steps.d: If the page has several colors or sizes, make sure it picked the right one.
One everyday action, like "open the lid and show the compartments".

faq.a: A public product page can still block access or require a login. If it does, upload the product photo instead.

faq.q: What do you take from the page?
faq.a: Only the main product photo and the product name. Prices, reviews and other text on the page are not used.

faq.q: Can I use a link to someone else's product?
faq.a: Only use links to products you own or are allowed to advertise, and only photos you have the rights to use.

faq.q: Can I change the photo you picked?
faq.a: Yes. If the photo isn't the best one, replace it with your own upload before you generate.

overview.h2: Start with the product page you already have
overview.p: A public product page can provide a starting photo and name. Describe one everyday action, such as opening a lid or lifting a bag, to turn the listing into a short scene.
